subject: Re: Scoped authn artifacts & bridge letter — clarification and delivery plan
messages:
From: Daniel Kwan <daniel.kwan@carenova.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audits@carenova.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request for SOC 2 Type II — scope clarification & authn samples

Maya,

Thanks for taking this — CareNova is preparing for our customer assessment and we need the SOC 2 Type II report plus targeted control artifacts to close a few open items. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following for our review:

- SOC 2 Type II report (full report + assertion) covering your most recent period
- Bridge letter if the report period does not fully cover our review window (we will confirm window below)
- MFA authentication challenge logs (time, user identifier, result, auth method) for a 60-day slice around Mar–Apr 2026
- Access review evidence (recertification export and remediation notes) for privileged roles
- Keystore rotation records and KMS audit entries for the last 12 months
- A small sample of privileged session recordings or session IDs (redacted) for escalation validation

Preferred format for logs: CSV or ndjson. If pseudonymization is required for user identifiers, please advise what mapping you can provide under NDA. We need an initial delivery by Jul 30 to keep our timeline.

Finally — our audit window is likely Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026. If your SOC 2 period differs, please indicate whether you can provide a bridge letter that covers the gap.

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Auditor, CareNova
Daniel.Kwan@carenova.com

---
Attachment: evidence_request_template.csv (blank CSV template)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Kwan <daniel.kwan@carenova.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request for SOC 2 Type II — scope clarification & authn samples

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Olga (Security) and Ben (Compliance) so we can coordinate delivery. A few clarifying points to make sure we scope exactly what you need:

1) Audit period: Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026. That matches the window you mentioned. If you require a signed bridge letter for any out-of-window transactions, we can produce one — Olga can flag any exclusions.

2) Authn slices: Do you want employee identities only, or should we include service accounts and contractors? Our default export includes all principal types; we can filter to "human" vs "service". We typically pseudonymize user IDs in external deliveries (sha256 hash of the internal id). If you need a reversible mapping we will need a specific legal/data-sharing agreement.

3) Privileged sessions: We can provide session metadata (session_id, user_hash, start/end, commands executed) and short redacted transcripts; full video recordings are restricted. Please confirm which fields are required.

4) Format & delivery: We can deliver CSV/ndjson via a secure transfer link (pre-authed S3) and provide a signed bridge letter (DocuSign) for any gap. Attaching a short checklist so we can mark which artifacts you want first.

Can you confirm the principal types (employees/service accounts) and whether CSV is acceptable? We will target an initial bundle by Aug 2 if that works for you.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: requested_items_checklist.xlsx (checklist to indicate which slices/formats you prefer)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Daniel Kwan <daniel.kwan@carenova.com>, audits@carenova.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — delivery plan and scope

Maya / Ben / Daniel — quick note on delivery and technical scope so expectations are aligned.

We can provide the following artifacts as discrete files in a secure bucket:
- MFA challenge logs (fields: timestamp, user_hash, result, factor_type, client_ip) — 60-day slice as requested
- Authn token traces / SAML assertion summaries (no raw assertions, we will provide metadata and hashes) — 90-day export if needed
- Access review package: recertification export (name, role, decision, reviewer, timestamp) plus remediation tickets for items changed in the period
- Keystore/KMS rotation entries: rotation timestamps, key IDs, actor identity (user_hash/service_id), and audit event ids
- Privileged session metadata: session_id, user_hash, start/end, elevated_action_flag, and redacted command list (no PII)

Notes: user identifiers will be pseudonymized (sha256) by default. If CareNova needs mapping, we can provide a mapping under an NDA/secure channel. File formats: CSV or ndjson — CSV is fine for everything above, ndjson recommended for the session traces if you plan automated ingestion.

I'll attach a draft bridge letter template with the formal language we typically sign — Maya, please review and confirm any additional contractual language we need to include. Proposed target: deliver initial bundle (MFA + access review + bridge draft) by Aug 2; full keystore and session samples by Aug 6. Let me know if you need acceleration.

Olga Petrov
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: draft_bridge_letter_template.docx (template for bridge letter)

From: Daniel Kwan <daniel.kwan@carenova.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, audits@carenova.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request for SOC 2 Type II — scope clarification & authn samples

Thanks — that plan looks good. A couple quick confirmations: 

- CSV is fine for all items. NDJSON would be OK for session traces but not required.
- Please include both employee and privileged service accounts in the authn slices; we will filter on our side.
- We will need the mapping for privileged accounts (hashed -> role) but that can be delivered under NDA.
- Privileged session metadata is sufficient (no need for video).

Once you have the bridge letter ready please send a DocuSign link to audits@carenova.com and I will route it to our legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Jul 30 is tight, Aug 2 delivery is acceptable.

Best,
Daniel
Senior Auditor, CareNova
